🚀 portracker | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Real-time network port monitoring and service discovery for self-hosted environments.
✨ Key Features: • Automatic Port Discovery • Platform-Specific Collectors (Docker, TrueNAS) • Internal Port Detection • Lightweight & Self-Contained (SQLite) • Peer-to-Peer Monitoring
📖 Summary: Portracker is an open-source, self-hosted tool that automatically discovers and monitors network ports and services on your systems. It provides a real-time, visual map of your network, helping to prevent deployment issues and eliminate manual tracking.
